Sz Ka Siao Pao (世界小報) is published
by the Little World, Chinese City, an amusement
resort. It deals mainly with the features of
entertainment to be found in the place.
1,200 copies are printed daily.
Editor: Yao Ming Ngai (姚民哀).

《世界小报》由位于华界游乐场所“大世界”的“Little World”出版。该报主要报道该场所内的娱乐特色。每日印行1,200份。

pages.en:
Hsin Wen Pao, 19 Hankow Road, Shanghai.
Daily paper. First number, Feb. 17, 1893.
Owned by the Sin Wan Pao Co., an American
corporation incorporated under the laws of
Delaware, with a capital of Tls. 100,000.
Financial position strong. Annual income
from advertisements $600,000. Circulation
claimed 30,000 in Shanghai and 80,000
elsewhere, but actual circulation probably
about 60,000. General reputation excellent and
is leading Chinese newspaper in Shanghai.
Caters more especially for the commercial
classes. Has established agencies in all
important centres in China and has corres-
pondents in London, Berlin, New York, Geneva,
Paris, Tokyo and Boston. Does not exchange
news. In home politics, stands for high
ideals in all matters of public interest;
has no political affiliations. As regards
foreign affairs inclines to be pro-American
and anti-Japanese.
A good advertising medium.
Director                Wang Han-hsi
Editor                  Li Hao-jan
Business Manager        Wang Po-ch'i

（批：18/2/24）
（批：via Yon Bros
ages 171-185）
pages.zh:
《新闻报》，上海汉口路19号。
日报。创刊于1893年2月17日。
由信远报公司（Sin Wan Pao Co.）所有，这是一家根据特拉华州法律注册的美国公司，资本为规元10万两。财务状况雄厚。广告年收入为60万美元。声称在上海的发行量为30,000份，其他地区为80,000份，但实际发行量可能约为60,000份。总体声誉极佳，是上海领先的中文报纸。尤其迎合商界人士的需求。在中国所有重要中心均设有代理机构，并在伦敦、柏林、纽约、日内瓦、巴黎、东京和波士顿设有通讯员。不进行新闻交换。在国内政治方面，主张在所有公共利益事务中秉持崇高理想；无政治派系隶属关系。在外交事务上倾向于亲美反日。
良好的广告媒介。
董事                王汉熙
编辑                李浩然
业务经理            王伯奇

（批注：18/2/24）
（批注：经 Yon Bros
页码 171-185）

Min Kuo Jih Pao (Republican Daily
News), 163 Shantung Road, Shanghai.
Daily paper. Founded 1916. Official
organ of the Kuo Min Tang Party,
Japanese registered. Caters for radical
politicians and students. General
reputation good. Circulation claimed
8000, probably actually about 5000.
Has correspondents in all important
Chinese centres and in Tokyo. Strongly
democratic and anti-Chihli Party.
Director                      Chao Chung-hui
Editor                        Yeh Ch'u -tā'ang
18/2/24

《民国日报》，上海山东路163号。
日报。成立于1916年。国民党官方机关报，在日本注册。迎合激进政治家和学生群体。总体声誉良好。声称发行量为8,000份，实际可能约为5,000份。在中国所有重要中心及东京设有通讯员。立场强烈民主且反对直系军阀。
董事                赵仲辉
编辑                叶楚伧

To Great World Journal. (大世界報) is
owned by the Great World Amusement Resort in the

entertainments provided by the resort.
It has a circulation of 4,000 per day. The
Manager is Wang Tseo Chiu (黄楚九).
